build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places dynamic bars, a static obstacle, and two balls in a scene
add_dynamic_bars: create a row of dynamic bars with increasing scale and 90 degree angle using C.add
add_static_obstacle: add a static bar obstacle at a configurable vertical position using C.add and set_bottom
update_task_goal: define the task goal by setting ball1 must touch bottom_wall via C.update_task with TOUCHING relationship
skip_invalid_params: raise SkipTemplateParams when the second ball overlaps with bars or the obstacle
